Gold Seized from Trinamool Leader's Aide in Bengal

Authorities in West Bengal have seized gold valued at approximately Rs 4.4 crore, weighing 3 kg, from an individual identified as an aide to a Trinamool leader. The recovery was made from the house of a Trinamool member. Investigations are reportedly underway to determine the extent of the link to Trinamool leader Sabyasachi Dutta.
